question: Should OpenClaw support this Discord-specific subagent progress configuration and channel lifecycle adapter as a permanent product/API surface?
rationale: Correctness review cannot decide whether seven new Discord settings, requester message metadata, persisted cleanup state, and the channel lifecycle adapter are the desired long-term contract.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped Discord feature
options.body: Accept the opt-in Discord-owned design after conflict resolution and exact-head behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the visible behavior but reduce the configuration fields or internalize the lifecycle seam before merge.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Close the PR if source-message subagent progress is not a supported bundled Discord capability.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped Discord feature
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in Discord-owned design after conflict resolution and exact-head behavior proof.
